chunks: Thus (Gog and Magog) could neither climb over it nor dig a hole through (the rampart).
ai.seo_question: Why could Gog and Magog not break through the wall built by Dhul-Qarnayn?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine wisdom behind the physical barrier of Gog and Magog, emphasizing that their confinement is not merely structural but a sign of God's sovereign control over history until the eschatological hour. The dual inability to 'overcome' or 'dig through' reflects both the strength of the construction and the temporary nature of their trial, serving as a reminder of the eventual emergence of chaos before the rise of the Mahdi.
